A1.justification: Both PDFs describe mmCooper and contain readable main text, equations, algorithms, tables, figures, and supplementary material. Retained content can be matched despite appendix expansion and relocation of the bibliography.

before.justification: v2 reports original detection experiments on OPV2V, DAIR-V2X, and V2XSet, including ablations, robustness tests, runtime measurements, and qualitative results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds V2V4Real results, further ablations, V2XSet robustness tests, and an agent-count study.

M1.justification: The CFG, MOF, BFC/DBA components, inference pipeline, and training losses remain the same. The single-round and shared-head explanations clarify the existing procedure. Diagram and pseudocode corrections largely align their descriptions with the method already specified in v2.

E1.justification: Supplementary Section 4.6 and Table 5 add V2V4Real, extending coverage to real-world vehicle-to-vehicle cooperation. This substantively broadens the represented deployment conditions beyond the retained simulated OPV2V/V2XSet and real-world vehicle-infrastructure DAIR-V2X evaluations.

E2.justification: Table 7 introduces a standard cross-attention replacement as a comparator for DBA. Comparator membership in the retained benchmark and runtime comparisons is unchanged; the V2V4Real comparison uses previously evaluated baseline methods.

E3.justification: New evaluation controls include replacing DBA with standard cross-attention and varying vehicle count from one to five. Section 4.3 corrects the stated MOF ablation from replacing DBA to replacing MOA with self-attention, while Table 3 scores remain unchanged; this does not establish a rerun. Principal metrics, training budgets, and existing noise settings are retained.

E4.justification: v3 substantially expands diagnostic evidence: V2XSet component and single-stage ablations, localization/delay/heading robustness curves on V2XSet, DBA versus cross-attention ablations across three datasets, and OPV2V agent-count sensitivity. These test component necessity and collaboration behavior beyond v2's existing analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for experimental outcomes. The Gaussian standard deviations describe injected perturbations, not uncertainty in estimated performance.

E6.justification: Substantial new results appear in Tables 4, 5, and 7 and Figures 10–13. On V2V4Real, mmCooper reports AP@0.7/0.5 of 31.47/50.21 versus Where2comm's 29.83/49.43. The new OPV2V cross-attention ablation reports 74.04/88.86 versus DBA's 78.11/88.93. These are newly reported comparisons; existing Tables 1–3 and the original runtime measurements remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Algorithm 1 revises the residual expression: v2 adds fused F^i to the DBA output, whereas v3 incorporates F_b(q) into DBA, matching the retained Section 3.5 equation. This is a limited mathematical correction, although the following F_DBA assignment becomes implicit. No new theoretical results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, adaptive multi-stage fusion, communication-efficiency, and robustness claims. Headline performance and communication-reduction claims on the original three datasets are unchanged.

C2.justification: New supplementary Section 3 explains practical efficiency through one processing/communication round and shared detection-head parameters, explicitly comparing runtime with ERMVP. Section 4.8 attributes the cross-attention ablation losses to insufficient focus on key reference points. Existing interpretations and applicability claims otherwise remain stable.

D1.justification: v3 adds a first-page code-access link, explicitly documents detection-head parameter sharing and single-round operation, and reports 2.71 ms per detection head. It also supplies V2XSet voxel and shared-feature dimensions. These are additional disclosures; the existing hardware, optimizer, batches, and training epochs remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Xu et al.'s V2V4Real dataset paper as reference 52 and expands the supplementary efficiency comparison with ERMVP. The related-work discussion and principal novelty positioning remain unchanged after matching renumbered references.

P1.justification: The main narrative remains largely verbatim. v3 adds an explanatory supplement section and experimental subsections, updates the supplementary outline, adds acknowledgements, and moves the bibliography after the supplement. These are localized structural and explanatory changes.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is substantially redrawn, including an explicit fused-feature connection to BFC. v3 adds the pipeline comparison in Figure 9, the agent-count plots in Figure 13, and Tables 4, 5, and 7. The three robustness figures expand from two dataset panels to three; retained qualitative figures and the runtime table are relocated or renumbered.

improvement.justification: V2V4Real evaluation and the targeted DBA, V2XSet, and agent-count analyses strengthen an already substantial empirical study. The clearer architecture diagram, implementation disclosures, and code link also improve usability. These gains are incremental, with unchanged headline results. Limited documentation drawbacks remain, including sparse agent-count protocol details and the omitted explicit F_DBA assignment in Algorithm 1.
